title: Evolution of microstructure and mechanical properties of cold spray additive manufactured aluminum deposit on copper substrate

preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: sanding, ultrasonic cleaning with alcohol for 5 min and then dried with a hair dryer

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: Samples with dimensions of 10 mm × 5 mm × 3 mm were cut from the prepared cold sprayed coatings by wire-cutting process. The samples were placed in the metallographic sample mosaic machine, and then 7.5 mL of the setting powder was poured into the machine and kept at 130 ◦C for 15 min to prepare the metallographic sample with a size of Φ 20 mm. The metallographic samples were successively polished with 600# to 5000# sandpaper, followed by polishing on the MP-1B machine with a 1.5 μm diamond polishing paste.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: grain size of the substrate significantly decreases after CS
